title: Molecular Dynamics Simulations Reveal Conformational Determinants of the Dynamic Association between alpha-Synuclein and Membranes.
journal: Journal of chemical information and modeling
one_liner_zh: 该文用分子动力学模拟研究α-突触核蛋白（IDP）与膜的结合机制，虽非PPI而是蛋白-膜互作，但无序蛋白构象动态与结合界面的建模思路对IDR介导互作机制研究有可迁移启发。
abstract: Interaction of alpha-synuclein with membranes is associated with normal cellular functions and the etiology of neurodegenerative diseases. Structural characterization of the membrane-bound alpha-synuclein is key to understanding the interaction mechanism. However, it represents a significant challenge because the intrinsically disordered nature of alpha-synuclein leads to a multitude of membrane-binding modes and highly dynamic conformations at the membrane surface. The present work investigated the binding of alpha-synuclein to a mixed POPC/POPG bilayer and provided atomic-level characterization of the protein-membrane complex based on extensive molecular dynamics simulations. The binding process is triggered by the adsorption of lysine residues to the negatively charged PG headgroups and results in differential binding modes stemming from the balance of heterogeneous intramolecular contacts of alpha-synuclein and its interaction with the membrane. The membrane-binding residues are primarily located in the first nine residues and the five imperfect KTKEGV repeats in the N-terminus. Network analysis of intramolecular interactions identifies the interaction between the N-terminus and C-terminus as the major interference factor in membrane binding. Repeats 1, 3, and 5 which are less engaged in intramolecular contacts display higher membrane-binding propensities, whereas Repeat 4 is the least membrane-bound due to strong interactions with Repeat 3, Repeat 5, and the C-terminus. Our results reveal crucial intramolecular interactions governing the membrane binding of alpha-synuclein and would enlighten the development of therapeutic strategies targeting the alpha-synuclein-membrane interaction.
abstract_zh: α-synuclein与膜的结合与正常细胞功能及神经退行性疾病的病因学相关。膜结合态α-synuclein的结构表征是理解其相互作用机制的关键。然而，这构成了一项重大挑战，因为α-synuclein的内在无序特性导致其存在多种膜结合模式及膜表面高度动态的构象。本研究探讨了α-synuclein与混合POPC/POPG双分子层的结合，并基于广泛的分子动力学 (molecular dynamics) 模拟，提供了蛋白质-膜复合物的原子级表征。结合过程由赖氨酸残基吸附至带负电的PG头基触发，并产生源于α-synuclein异质分子内接触与其膜相互作用之间平衡的差异结合模式。膜结合残基主要位于前九个残基及N端五个不完全重复的KTKEGV序列中。分子内相互作用的网络分析识别出N端与C端之间的相互作用为膜结合的主要干扰因素。较少参与分子内接触的重复序列1、3和5表现出较高的膜结合倾向，而重复序列4因与重复序列3、重复序列5及C端的强相互作用而膜结合最少。我们的结果揭示了调控α-synuclein膜结合的关键分子内相互作用，并将启发针对α-synuclein-膜相互作用的治疗策略的开发。
